title: Engineering microbial cell factories for the production of lycopene: Advances and perspectives.
authors: Huang, Guangxi; Lan, Yibin; Duan, Changqing; Yan, Guoliang
one_liner_zh: 该文综述微生物细胞工厂生产番茄红素的代谢工程策略，虽提及转录因子工程和机器学习，但核心是代谢产物合成而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Lycopene, a high-value carotenoid widely used as a natural colorant and antioxidant in the agri-food industry, is currently produced in microbial cell factories. We first summarize recent advances in microbial cell factory-based lycopene production. Next, we review metabolic engineering strategies that enhance lycopene biosynthesis-pathway flux modulation, cofactor optimization, transcription factor engineering, efflux engineering, etc. We also spotlight the application of emerging technologies-multi-enzyme scaffolding, high-throughput screening and machine learning-in lycopene synthesis. Aligning with green-manufacturing goals, we review progress on lycopene biosynthesis from feedstocks such as lignocellulose, methanol, CO(2) and PET. Finally, we discuss strategies for enhancing cellular robustness to mitigate scale-up constraints. The integrated approaches presented here provide insights for overproducing lycopene, other carotenoids and structurally related terpenoids.
abstract_zh: 番茄红素（lycopene）是一种高价值类胡萝卜素，在农业食品工业中广泛用作天然着色剂和抗氧化剂，目前通过微生物细胞工厂生产。我们首先总结了基于微生物细胞工厂的番茄红素生产的最新进展。接着，我们综述了增强番茄红素生物合成的代谢工程策略，包括途径通量调控、辅因子优化、转录因子工程、外排工程等。我们还重点介绍了新兴技术——多酶支架、高通量筛选和机器学习——在番茄红素合成中的应用。与绿色制造目标一致，我们回顾了从木质纤维素、甲醇、CO(2)和PET等原料进行番茄红素生物合成的进展。最后，我们讨论了增强细胞稳健性以缓解规模化限制的策略。本文提出的综合方法为过量生产番茄红素、其他类胡萝卜素及结构相关的萜类化合物提供了见解。
